values.StartLocation: Metering and interconnect facility, Burrell Township
values.EndLocation: Homer City Generating Station, Center Township
values.DataCenterNotes: The related data center is the Homer City Energy Campus in Center and Blacklick townships, Indiana County, Pennsylvania, on the site of the former Homer City coal plant. Homer City Redevelopment is building a 4.5 GW gas-fired power plant there, with Kiewit as builder and seven GE Vernova turbines. Developers put the first investment above $10 billion on a 3,200 acre site. A May 2026 local news report says construction began in April 2026 and the plant should produce power in 2028, while the 2025 announcement said 2027. Amazon Web Services said in August 2026 that it was in talks with the developer without a final deal. A DatacenterDynamics article from October 2026 says Amazon Data Services then filed a land development plan for 36 data center buildings on 1,100 acres. It says most of the plant's output would serve the campus and more than 1 GW would go to the grid. Earlier coverage named no tenant.

researcher_notes: No existing row covers this line. A Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection fact sheet for permit PAD320011 describes about 5.8 miles of 30-inch steel gas pipe from a metering and interconnect facility in Burrell Township north to the Homer City Generating Station in Center Township. The applicant is Homer City Generation, L.P. A May 2026 local news report on the state hearing gives the same length and size and says the pipeline would serve the power plant that feeds the Homer City data center campus. A March 2026 report says the same. The fact sheet itself does not mention the data center, so the data center tie rests on the two news reports. This is a dedicated supply line to one plant, not a utility distribution main, even though the state calls it a gas distribution pipeline. Status is proposed because the state permit was still under review after the May 2026 hearing. An older report of about 5 miles from Texas Eastern near Blairsville is treated as the same line. Pipeline type, proposal year and cost were not confirmed. Route was not found in public map files. Entity lookup found no close existing owner, and the name keeps the ownership team style.
